##### Project general facts

Montiva by Vida is a refined residential project nestled within the vibrant Dubai Creek Harbour—a destination where contemporary architecture meets serene waterfront living. Designed with VIDA’s signature aesthetic, Montiva offers a unique lifestyle surrounded by lush gardens, botanical escapes, and panoramic views of the skyline, creek, and parks. The development harmonizes upscale urban design with the calming presence of nature, creating a tranquil retreat in one of Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods.

Every detail at Montiva encourages well-being and community. Residents can enjoy a wide array of wellness-focused amenities, including multi-sport courts, climbing walls, running tracks, indoor and outdoor gyms, and beautifully landscaped green spaces. Families will find areas for children to play and explore, such as splash zones and themed playgrounds. The central park, social hubs, and BBQ lawns further support a lifestyle where relaxation, connection, and vitality are at the forefront.

Situated in the peaceful Green Gate District of Dubai Creek Harbour, Montiva is perfectly connected to city life with easy access to Downtown Dubai, the airport, and future metro lines. Whether it's a spontaneous dinner in the city or a quiet morning by the infinity pool, Montiva blends natural tranquillity with urban convenience. Developed by Emaar, one of the world’s leading real estate brands, this project is more than a home—it’s a gateway to inspired living.
 
##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Creek Harbour stands at the heart of a bold new vision for Dubai, set to redefine the boundaries of architecture, design, and modern living. Spanning eight square kilometres along the historic Dubai Creek, this waterfront destination features Creek Beach — Dubai’s first-of-its-kind urban beach — offering 700 metres of pristine white sand, an infinity pool, and breathtaking sunset views. Conceived as the ultimate family-friendly retreat, Creek Beach brings a resort-style atmosphere into the heart of the city.

The centerpiece of Dubai Creek Harbour is the iconic Dubai Creek Tower, designed by world-renowned architect Santiago Calatrava. Poised to surpass the Burj Khalifa in height, this architectural marvel symbolizes Dubai’s forward-looking spirit and its relentless pursuit of innovation. The tower is set to become a global landmark, reflecting the city’s ambitions on the world stage.

Dubai Creek Harbour offers a wide array of residential options, from luxurious waterfront apartments to modern villas, all designed with contemporary aesthetics and sustainability in mind. Residents enjoy panoramic views of the Creek, the Dubai skyline, and the future Dubai Creek Tower. With its blend of cutting-edge design, cultural depth, and lifestyle-driven planning, Dubai Creek Harbour embodies the future of urban waterfront living.
